title: Zuga
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Niddah.3.2.9), Rabbi Yirmeyah said: Zuga went outside; Rabbi Chama, father of Rabbi Hoshaya, and Bar Kappara asked him a question. Zuga then came and asked Rabbi. Hyman proposes reading Zuna, as in [Maaser Sheni, beginning of chapter 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.5.1.2): Zuna asked Rabbi. We also find in [Bava Batra 164b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.164b.5): Zunin said to Rabbi.

notes.text: The linked Niddah witness reads Zuga, while Maaser Sheni names Zuna. In Bava Batra, Zunin speaks directly to Rabbi about the dating of a folded document, also discussed in [Heilprin’s Zunin entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1108&lang=en). Hyman uses these forms to propose Zuna in Niddah. That identification remains his proposal.
